text:
sofia: Quick sync — SKU flooring plan for next-quarter HW launch with Nimbus + SI onboarding. Need to agree commit tiers, renewal anchor language, and seller ops play. Who's taking the lead on seller enablement?
ajay: I can drive seller ops but need final commit thresholds. Are we doing tiered discounts or flat credits?
mike: leaning tiered. quick draft:```
Bronze: $50k commit -> 5% marketplace discount
Silver: $200k commit -> 12% discount + 1 month pilot credit
Gold: $500k commit -> 20% discount + 3 months pilot credits + priority SLA
```agreeable?
elaine: Legal: watch auto-renew phrasing. If renewal is automatic, need 30-day opt-out and explicit usage reconciliation clause. Also confirm minimum term (12 months?) and how unused credits carry over.
sofia: Good call. Proposal: 12mo term, auto-renew unless customer opts out 30d before term end, unused pilot credits expire at term end but they can apply to renewal with approval. We'll add a reconciliation schedule quarterly.
ajay: For marketplace gating: do we restrict private offers to Silver+ only? Nimbus wants to push heavier deals to their field. If gating Silver+, we should provide a seller-facing FAQ and a template PO.
mike: SI onboarding timeline: training content by 2025-06-10, enablement call week of 2025-06-16, pilot cohort starts 2025-07-01. SI wants a packaged private-offer template and a SKU bundle that maps to commit tiers.
els: (small typo)
elaine: Also request: include a clause requiring anonymized usage telemetry for quality monitoring — necessary for model routing adjustments. Ops must be able to opt out for regulated customers.
sofia: Noted. I'll draft the seller enablement doc + a one-pager for Nimbus that includes: tier table, renewal bullets, gating rules, PO template, and FAQ. Target to share with this thread by 2025-05-22.
ajay: I'll draft the PO template and sample seller email. Will also sync with field leads in EMEA.
mike: I'll package the SI enablement slides and the SKU mapping matrix. Quick question: do we surface the actual discount % in public marketplace listing or hide behind private offers?
ajay: Hide on public listing. Public SKU shows MSRP and available for contact; discounts applied in private offers only. Keeps price integrity.
ops-bot: Document created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PART/pages/PRICING-185/sku-flooring-and-si-onboarding (ops note: internal link) :spiral_calendar:
sofia: Perfect. Last thing — renewal messaging: propose "renewal anchor" in PO: commit next term >= 80% of prior consumed volume to keep discount tier, otherwise tier re-evaluated. Thoughts?
elaine: 80% anchor is ok but add a grace period of one quarter for net-new integrations. Also include discretionary review clause for anomalies.
ajay: sounds fair. I'll add to seller FAQ and the sample renewal email.
sofia: Awesome — owners: ajay = seller ops & PO template, mike = SI slides + SKU matrix, elaine = review legal clauses, me = seller one-pager + thread doc. Target: all drafts in wiki by 2025-05-22.
mike: ✅
ajay: ✅
elaine: ✅
sofia: Thanks team :tada: — will follow up with review thread when drafts are live.
